reasons.timeout: the site took too long to answer
reasons.deadline: the scan ran out of time before this check could finish
reasons.probe_cooldown: checked recently, showing the earlier result
reasons.check_error: the checker failed to run this check
reasons.owner_opt_out: the owner turned off active checks
reasons.out_of_scope: this check was outside what the scan covers for this site
reasons.not_available: the checker does not run this check yet
reasons.opt_in_required: this check runs only when the site owner opts in

outcomes.blocked: something stopped this check before it could finish
